_comment: Which file may read which key (PiersAG/app-business-core#760, #484). Names only, never a value. lib/secrets.ts takes every `scrub: true` key out of process.env at server start, so a package in the dependency tree that reads process.env finds nothing; the files listed under `readers` get the key through readSecret(). tests/unit/key-access.test.ts fails when a file reads a key it is not listed for, when a scrubbed key is read straight from process.env, or when a `secret` line in .env.contract has no entry here. A new key is one entry in this file plus its line in .env.contract.

AUTH_SECRET.why_not_scrubbed: The sign-in library reads it in the Edge middleware as well as on the server; the Edge runtime has no start-up hook to hand it over, so it stays in the environment. It is used only by the sign-in library.

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.why_not_scrubbed: Older name for AUTH_SECRET; same reason.
